notes.title: Tycoon strategy game Car Park Capital gets a new trailer and publisher announcement
notes.notes:
Car Park Capital is an absolutely genius idea for a tycoon building sim, getting you to build up the greatest car parks ever.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/08/tycoon-strategy-game-car-park-capital-gets-a-new-trailer-and-publisher-announcement/

notes.title: Publishing Partnership with MicroProse!
notes.notes:
[p]Great news:[b] I signed with a publisher![/b][/p][p]The one behind great classics like Transport Tycoon, Civilization, and that game where you build rollercoasters and drown people for fun: It’s [b]MicroProse[/b]![/p][p]Considering my game is inspired by some of their classics, MicroProse feels like the perfect match, and so I’m very honored with this partnership.[/p][p][/p][p]Car Park Capital is a new - but old-school - tycoon game where you turn walkable towns into parking lots and use propaganda to convince people to pay you for it.[/p][p][b]Have you seen the trailer yet?[/b] It was made for this announcement![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="Ae3MtHDfSr4;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
[/p][p]A [b]big thanks[/b] to all of you, for the support, enthusiasm and wishlists, and a big thanks to MicroProse![/p][p][/p][p]Now that I have left my day job, I can work on the game full time, with support from MicroProse on marketing, localization, funding and more. This means a better game![/p][p]
Banana cars, hippie vans, tricycle motorbikes, cabriolets, yank tanks and more await you, in your own parking paradise![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45056271/99fa0c11e158e5ea6d6e6026d9dff397b8930360.gif"][/img] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45056271/d868457c8fe472c9fd11d730bbf35d96f7434e30.gif"][/img][/p][p]Join the Discord to chat about the game and to stay up to date on development![/p][p][/p][p]-Hilko (@hilkojj)[/p]
